transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, doctor. Thank you so much for seeing me. Um, I hope I'm explaining this right, but... I guess I'm just having a little bit of trouble keeping things neat lately? It's probably normal, you know, being busy, but I'm trying to balance my schoolwork and this little accessories shop I run, and I just feel like I can't get them organized at the same time. 

Like, my crafting supplies, due dates, receipts, and my assignment notes... they all just sort of end up in these piles. And then I just stare at them and I don't really know what to do first. It's not a huge disaster or anything, but it gets a little overwhelming. I'm sorry, I know that probably sounds a bit silly, but does that make sense? Is that the kind of thing you can help with?
Did you struggle with staying organized when you were growing up, such as in elementary or middle school?

Oh, um, growing up? Well... I'm not totally sure if it was exactly about being disorganized, but I guess I was just a really... enthusiastic kid? I hope it doesn't make me sound like I was a bad student or anything, because I really did want to do a good job! 

But, um... my mom actually still has some of my old notes from my elementary school teachers. And they would say that I was, well, out of my seat a lot. And that I had a habit of talking before I was called on. I think I just got really eager to participate, you know? They also mentioned that I would kind of rush through group activities, even when I completely understood the work. I just always wanted to keep moving on to the next thing, I guess. 

Does that... does that make sense? I'm sorry if that wasn't exactly what you were asking about with the organization part, but is that the kind of thing you mean?
Nowadays, do you still feel physically restless or have trouble sitting still, like you constantly need to be on the move?

Um... yeah, I guess I do still have a little bit of that. I really try not to be disruptive, I promise! But, um... even when I'm not actually going anywhere, or I don't have a specific place to be, I just get this... this feeling like my body is sort of buzzing? 

Like I just really, really need to be moving. It mostly happens when I'm supposed to just sit still and listen to someone, like in a long class. I try so hard to keep it in because I'd hate for anyone to think I'm being rude or ignoring them. I usually just bounce my leg under the table or fidget with my rings so no one notices. 

Is that... does that sound like what you mean? I hope I'm giving you the right kind of answers.
